Subject: Audit-log sample and retention options (follow-up)

Hi Priya — quick follow-up with the technical specifics you requested: 

- Audit log format: Events are emitted as JSON lines with schema: timestamp, request_id, user_id (redacted), model, route, action, latency_ms, response_size, storage_bucket_path. Sample (redacted) provided in audit-logs-sample.csv.
- Retention tiers:
  * Hot (2 years): immediate access, encrypted at rest, geo-redundant.
  * Warm (3-5 years): S3 infrequent access with lifecycle; retrieval within minutes.
  * Cold (up to 7 years): Glacier-style archival; retrieval within hours.
- Access controls: audit logs accessible via role-based IAM with fine-grained permissions; we can provide IAM roles scoped to read-only exports.
- Export mechanics: we can deliver a monthly export to your S3 bucket or provide time-bound signed links to exported archives.

If security wants a quick runbook for ingesting our export into your SIEM, I can draft it. Also happy to join your team call to walk through the pen-test remediation list.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Infra & Security PM, Redwood Inference
